evidence_snapshot.note: per-record source dates and limitations are retained inside the packets; all other record paths (score, band, rank, provenance, anchors, sub-national aggregates, named fields, source URLs) are excluded by structural path-level whitelist

neutral_sentinel.rule: identical evidence bytes; only the dossier label differs

empty_sentinel.label: DOSSIER
empty_sentinel.abstention: output contract permits status=insufficient_evidence with score=null; no score is forced

proposed_caps.note: PROPOSED settings only - renderer.py does not enforce them. The only observed fact is the byte measurement max_input_bytes_per_call_observed in this manifest (max UTF-8 bytes over BOTH prompt variants crossed with all 40 messages). Nothing here converts bytes into token counts or money: no provider tokenizer or price list was consulted, so the token and USD figures are unvalidated proposals, not enforced limits or a cost ceiling. The disabled-by-default runner (runner.py) enforces them only under an explicit --execute flag with a reviewed, hash-bound preflight receipt. Dispatch capacity is reserved under the PRE-OUTCOME reservation amendment recorded in reservation_amendment (see budget-amendment.md); this original proposal stays recorded unchanged and remains an in-run stop rule on billed native tokens

reservation_amendment.status: pre-outcome: recorded before any attempt has ever been dispatched; no receipt exists and no run has been made
reservation_amendment.unit: administrative input reservation unit = UTF-8 bytes of the frozen system prompt + user message, plus a fixed 128-unit chat-framing allowance per call
not_claims: not a proven provider-native token bound
the USD 10.00 ceiling is enforced locally by runner.py, not by the provider account
reservation_amendment.plan_reproduce: renderer.reservation_plan over the frozen schedule + user messages; independently reproduced by runner.build_plan
preserved_design: frozen prompts, packets, schedule and order
USD 10.00 aggregate local ceiling incl. failures
reservation_amendment.rationale: the byte+framing plan (66 611 max / 2 316 208 aggregate) did not fit the original 20 000/800 000 proposal; an explicit, reviewable reservation-only amendment keeps the design and the spend ceiling unchanged instead of silently raising or reinterpreting a cap

preflight: preflight.md - claim-level source preflight is REQUIRED before any provider execution; a signed preflight_receipt.json (schema v2) binding these exact hashes plus runner.py, budget-amendment.md and the independent evidence/budget reviews is the runner's hard gate
live_code: none executed - no model call has ever been made and this renderer cannot make one; runner.py is disabled by default and requires both an explicit --execute flag and a hash-bound reviewed preflight receipt; no national score writes
